title: Recent advances in first-row transition metal clusters for photocatalytic water splitting
claim: Improved cluster-photocatalyst design requires operando understanding of metal valence states, reaction intermediates, and changes in catalyst identity.
explanation: Despite reported activity gains from metal composition, ligand control, nuclearity, and cluster–support interfaces, the review identifies incomplete mechanistic understanding as a persistent obstacle.
scope: First-row transition-metal cluster photocatalysts for water splitting.
caveats: The review presents this as a research need rather than a demonstrated mechanism or guaranteed route to higher activity.
